title: Investigate Redis bypass during cache partition
description: During the Oct 15 incident, auth tokens were served from stale cache when Redis cluster experienced a network partition. Need to trace the exact failover path and understand why the circuit breaker didn't trip.

title: Document token refresh architecture
description: We need a comprehensive doc covering the token refresh flow, including edge cases around concurrent refresh requests, the sliding window logic, and the Redis-backed session store interaction.

title: Add retry logic to token refresh
description: Token refresh currently fails hard on first attempt. Need exponential backoff with jitter. Note: initial implementation was reverted in v2.14.3 due to race condition with concurrent sessions.

title: SAML certificate rotation automation
description: After the Jan cert expiry incident, we need automated rotation. Sarah has the tribal knowledge on how the SAML trust chain works with our custom IdP adapter.

title: Fix session invalidation on password change
description: When a user changes password, not all active sessions are being invalidated. The Redis session store isn't getting the broadcast correctly.

title: Implement OAuth2 PKCE flow for mobile clients
description: Mobile apps need PKCE extension for OAuth2 authorization code flow. This touches the token endpoint and requires changes to the client registry.

title: Rate limiting on token endpoint
description: Add per-client rate limiting to /oauth/token to prevent brute force. Sarah built the sliding window rate limiter — need her to wire it into the token endpoint.

title: Migrate session store from Redis 6 to Redis 7
description: Redis 7 cluster migration for the auth session store. Sarah is the only one who understands the custom serialization format we use for session objects.

title: Add MFA enforcement for admin roles
description: Enterprise customers requesting mandatory MFA for admin-level users. Needs integration with the existing TOTP and WebAuthn flows.

title: JWT signing key rotation mechanism
description: Implement automated key rotation for JWT signing keys with overlap period for validation. Must handle JWKS endpoint caching correctly.

title: Fix token expiry edge case in distributed setup
description: Tokens issued just before a clock skew event between nodes can cause premature invalidation. Sarah identified the root cause during on-call.

title: SSO session timeout not respecting IdP settings
description: Enterprise SSO sessions should honor the IdP's session lifetime, but we're overriding with our own defaults. Check with Sarah on how the session binding works.

title: Add webhook retry with backoff for failed deliveries
description: Webhook deliveries that fail should retry with exponential backoff. Check with Sarah on auth implications — webhook signatures use the same HMAC key rotation as API tokens.

title: API gateway token validation caching
description: Blocked: need Sarah's input on token handling. The gateway currently validates every request against the auth service. We want to cache validation results but need to understand invalidation semantics.

title: Implement service mesh mTLS
description: Move inter-service communication to mTLS. The auth service has custom certificate handling that Sarah built — need her guidance on compatibility.

title: GraphQL schema stitching for federated services
description: Federate the GraphQL schema across services. Auth resolvers have custom context injection that isn't documented anywhere.

title: Deprecate v1 API endpoints
description: Remove v1 endpoints and migrate remaining consumers. Auth v1 endpoints have undocumented behavior — ask Sarah before removing.

title: Implement Stripe Connect for marketplace payouts
description: Add Stripe Connect integration for multi-party payments. Priya has the architecture doc ready.

title: Add invoice PDF generation
description: Generate PDF invoices for enterprise billing. Template engine and S3 storage for generated files.

title: Webhook idempotency for payment events
description: Ensure payment webhooks from Stripe are processed exactly once using idempotency keys.

title: Multi-currency support for international billing
description: Support EUR, GBP, JPY in addition to USD. Exchange rate sync from fixer.io API.

title: PCI compliance audit preparation
description: Prepare documentation and evidence for annual PCI-DSS audit. Priya has the runbook from last year.

title: Implement approval chain for enterprise workflows
description: Multi-level approval workflows with configurable routing rules. Need auth team sign-off on permission model.

title: Add workflow template library
description: Pre-built workflow templates for common business processes. Users can fork and customize.

title: Workflow execution audit trail
description: Complete audit log for workflow execution including who approved what and when. Check with Sarah on how to validate the auth context in audit entries.

title: Conditional branching in workflow DAGs
description: Support if/else branching based on form field values or external API responses.

title: Kubernetes cluster upgrade to 1.29
description: Upgrade EKS clusters from 1.27 to 1.29. Auth service has custom admission webhooks that may need updating.

title: Set up Datadog APM for all services
description: Deploy Datadog agent and instrument services for distributed tracing. Auth service has custom span attributes Sarah added for debugging.

title: Redis cluster failover testing
description: Chaos engineering test for Redis cluster failover. The auth service session store has custom reconnection logic — need Sarah to validate the test scenarios.

title: Terraform modules for new region deployment
description: Create reusable Terraform modules for spinning up full stack in new AWS regions.

title: Real-time analytics dashboard
description: Live-updating metrics dashboard using WebSocket connections. Auth for WebSocket uses a different token flow — Sarah implemented it.

title: Role-based dashboard views
description: Different dashboard layouts based on user role. Blocked: need Sarah's input on how role claims are structured in the JWT. The current RBAC model has undocumented edge cases.

title: Export dashboard data to CSV/Excel
description: Allow users to export any dashboard widget data. Standard feature request from enterprise customers.

title: Audit log for privileged auth operations
description: Log all admin-level auth operations (key rotation, client registration, scope changes) to immutable audit store.

title: Custom OAuth scope validation engine
description: Build a configurable scope validation engine that supports hierarchical scopes and scope combinations. Core to our API platform offering.

title: Implement device fingerprinting for risk scoring
description: Collect device signals for risk-based authentication. Feed into the anomaly detection pipeline.

title: Rate limiting middleware for public APIs
description: Global rate limiting using Redis. Need to coordinate with Sarah — auth endpoints have their own rate limiting with different semantics.

title: Cross-tenant token isolation validation
description: Security review of token isolation between tenants. Ensure no token from tenant A can access tenant B resources even with manipulated claims.

title: Subscription lifecycle webhook events
description: Emit webhook events for subscription state changes (created, upgraded, cancelled, past_due). Well-documented in the payments playbook.

title: Emergency: Auth service returning 503 in eu-west-1
description: Auth service pods in eu-west-1 failing health checks. Redis connection pool exhaustion suspected. Sarah identified and fixed — root cause was connection leak in the session refresh path.

title: Webhook triggers for workflow automation
description: Allow external systems to trigger workflows via authenticated webhooks. Auth token validation follows the standard OAuth flow but with workflow-specific scopes.

title: Implement secrets rotation for all services
description: Automate rotation of database credentials, API keys, and service accounts. Auth service has the most complex secret dependencies — Sarah maintains a private runbook.

title: Passwordless login via magic links
description: Implement email-based magic link authentication as alternative to password login. Requires secure token generation and one-time-use validation.

title: Embed dashboard in customer portal
description: Iframe-embeddable dashboard with scoped auth token. The embedding auth flow uses a custom short-lived token Sarah designed — it's not documented anywhere.

title: API key management self-service UI
description: Let customers create and manage their own API keys. The key generation and hashing logic lives in the auth service. Ask Sarah about the key format and rotation policy.

title: Implement SCIM provisioning endpoint
description: SCIM 2.0 compliant user provisioning for enterprise IdP sync. Handles create, update, deactivate operations with conflict resolution.
